extras: The font used is linja-pona by musilili.net, jan Wesi and David A Roberts which is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License.
intentEvidence: This plugin allows you to toggle between regular and Sitelen Pona font for notes written in Toki Pona.
problem: Users writing in Toki Pona require a simple way to display the specialized Sitelen Pona font within their notes.
summary: Allows users to toggle between regular and Sitelen Pona fonts for notes written in Toki Pona.
